# Modifications

- No file is modified. `Animations/gltf/Rig_Medium/` is renamed `Rig_Medium/`.
- The `.meta` files are Sapphire's import sidecars, not part of the pack. They say `cook: false` until M2 N1's clip importer takes these files; nothing cooks or packs them before that.

## Derived files

None yet. M2 O2 retargets the clips it uses onto the character at cook time and lists any committed result here.
